'''Cecil Hugh (Hugh) Tyndale-Biscoe''' {{Post-nominals|country=AUS|AM|FAA}} (born 16 October 1929 [[Srinagar]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (princely state)|Kashmir]]) is an Australian [[zoologist]].<ref name=EAS>{{Cite web|url=http://www.eoas.info/biogs/P003520b.htm|title=Tyndale-Biscoe, Cecil Hugh (Hugh)|website=Encyclopedia of Australian Science|language=en-gb|access-date=2024-02-06}}</ref>  He was Chief Research Scientist, CSIRO Division of Wildlife and Rangelands Research from 1978 to 1992.

==Awards==
* [[Clarke Medal]] (1974)<ref name=EAS />
* Fellow of the [[Australian Academy of Science]] (1986)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hugh Tyndale-Biscoe |url=https://www.science.org.au/profile/hugh-tyndale-biscoe |access-date=2024-02-07 |website=Australian Academy of Science |language=en}}</ref>
* [[Member of the Order of Australia]] (AM) (Australia Day 2018 Honours List)<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dr Cecil Hugh Tyndale-Biscoe |url=https://honours.pmc.gov.au/honours/awards/2000703 |access-date=2024-02-07 |website=Australian Honours Search Facility}}</ref>
